basic_info.description: Introducing ATRIUM-the 2-level residence at Sol de Dolores, a bespoke 3-home development by a world-renowned architect known for skyline-defining work in SF, LA, and Honolulu. ATRIUM is the largest of the 3 homes, a light-filled marvel anchored by a dramatic open-air light court with spiral staircase and floor-to-ceiling glass. Blue skies & sunlight are delivered directly to the home's living spaces, creating an uplifting sense of openness. The kitchen is centered around an oversized Cambria Portrush quartz island with bold blue veining w/ breakfast bar seating, dual Wolf ovens, Wolf induction cooktop, SubZero refrigerator, Cove dishwasher, custom two-toned cabinetry... a true showroom kitchen! The primary suite is tucked away at the rear for privacy, with a walk-in closet, private porch, & ensuite bath featuring floating vanities, an oversized porcelain-tiled shower, & brass Kohler fixtures. The 2nd bedroom (currently staged as an office) abuts the atrium and is served by a luxe hall bath. Upstairs, a 3rd bedroom opens directly to a massive private rooftop terrace. Other features include wide-plank oak floors, AC, programmable lighting scenes, Ubiquiti WiFi6, solar, EV-ready 1-car parking, CAT6, ceiling fans, & closets outfitted w/organizing systems. Live in the light at ATRIUM!
